nom: Perricone MD Vitamin C Ester Citrus Brightening Cleanser

avis.texte: I have been using this cleanser for over a year and I'm happy with the results. I have melasma spots and it helps brighten those, especially in the summer when they tend to get darker.
I can not say it made a difference to my skin. I used it for 3 weeks but nothing has happened. My skin neither felt dry or moisturized.
I love it. It's not harsh at all. Removes oil without drying out my skin. A little goes a long way.
This cleanser really removes my makeup and I wear IT CC Cream Foundation which needs a heavy duty cleanser.

avis.titre: I always go back this this!
avis.texte: This is the only face wash I use anymore. It's gentle on my skin yet very effective. When I ran out last time, I tried using the Murad vitamin c cleanser and it doesn't compare. This is the holy grail of cleanser - my pores appear smaller and my skin is glowing.
Love this brightener. I tried to change to something else when I ran out and it was a terrible idea!
This is my first time in using this brand of product and I find it to be exactly what it says. It is with immediate results.
I love this cleanser. The thick consistency allows you to use it sparingly. A pea is enough to form foam on your face. Super. I'm happy and will buy more

avis.titre: I love this product and use it daily
avis.texte: I love this product, unfortunately my local Ulta is almost always out of stock
Nice cleanser but again very pricey, not sure if you actually need one that costs this much. It does make your face feel refreshed but not sure if it's worth the price.
I was given this as a gift. I found it is the best face wash ever. I am 58 years old . I have used all kind of stuff and will never go back this is the only one I will use. I give 100% great

This is the best facial cleanser I know. I have combination skin, so I find most facial cleaners either too harsh or not cleaning enough. This one is the perfect one for me. I love how it makes my skin glow and makes it look healthy.

I really loved this product. I wanted to try a new facial cleanser. I also tried it after removing make up and wow amazing. I usually use make up remover and hate how oily my skin feels after but using this removing make up it removed it all and while washing my face with tb cleanser. It makes my skin feel so clean and leaves it a nice glow.

I got this because i left my usual cleanser in the hotel i was staying in England, a little pricey but works for me, leaves my skin super hydrated and removes dirt and makeup, maybe because the vitamin C but leaves a glowy and refined skin.

as a teen i love love love loveeeee this face wash it for sure brightens and does what its supposed to and feels so smooth on the skin and after it leaves it super amooth and leave a clean like feeling and does not dry me out or nothing i use it every 2 days ( i have oily skin )
I felt an Immediate change in my skin. Wonderfully hydrating. Can't believe one product would make so much of a difference. Worth the splurge.
Could see skin brightening after first use. Nice gel type cleaner and removes makeup well. I didn't find it to moisturizing, but not drying either. Rinses well.

This is now my new "favorite of the month"'cleanser. I have every Perricone cleanser EXCEPT for acne. (I don't have acne). This is a very refreshing cleanser. Smells wonderful and not overwhelming. Feels lighter than the Nutritive Cleanser, the CBD Cleanser is a close 2nd to this. I absolutely love it! Hope u do, as well! Very lightweight and refreshing!
I use it along with all my perricone..it makes such a difference
I noticed a difference in my skin after a few weeks of using this! I have gotten compliments on how much brighter I look.
I like this cleanser for my morning routine as well as warm weather days.Just wish the tub was bigger.It rinses really well and my skin feels ready for my Moisturizer.

I really wish I didn't fall in love with this cleanser because of the price but I've tried a ton of cleaners and never have I found the one that my skin needs until now. It removes all my makeup, makes my skin feel clean and fresh without drying it out. The scent is nice and lux. Makes me feel like im at the spa each time I cleanse.

This has been my favorite cleanser although it a tighter, squeakier clean than the Nutritive cleanser. So, I switch off with the two. I have combination skin, with fine lines around my mouth but oily in my T zone.
Very nice cleanser, doesn't make my skin dry and irritated. Love to start my morning routine with this cleanser. The smell is nice too!

This cleanser might be a bit pricey but I have repurchased 3 times.It has helped reduce the appearance of my dark spots from blemishes and makes my skin feel so moisturized and supple after washing. I usually use this at night and a salicylic acid cleanser in the morning but lately I've been using just the perricone, my skin is happy. I always tell people about my face skin cleanser when they ask what I use!
I absolutely love this gel. It is now my absolute most used item in my collection. It lathers really well and smells like an orange. It rinses off good and doesn't leave any funky residue.
This cleanser is the only one I use. Very gentle yet so effective. Helps my skin glow.
I got this in my BoxyCharm around a year ago. It cleared my face up and evened my skin tone. I will usually use it first to get my makeup off!
Use daily, leaves my skin feeling smooth not tight, lathers well, no overbearing fragrance which is a plus.

I tried many different cleansers and this one works well at removing makeup. I bought it when it was half price, otherwise I do not think I would pay full price for it. I use it in the evenings. It does not dry out my skin. A small amount goes a long way.

I absolutely love love love this cleanser. It is gentle on my skin yet cleans it to a dewy glow. I am 53 and feel like my clean skin actually looks beautiful. I never ever want to be without it. I just bought two so that I don't run out.

avis.titre: Broke out and dried out skin
avis.texte: I gave this a good month try. I broke out terribly and continued to the whole month, even my fiancé noticed a difference in my skin. Once I stopped and started using the face wash I used before this, my skin instantly looked better. Also, it left me with such a dry feeling afterwards. This definitely didn't work for me and I'll be giving to somebody else or tossing.
This cleanser is gentle enough even though I don't have sensitive skin I found this cleanser to clean my skin well and does not over dry my skin.

i received this in my boxycharm for october and at first, the product was amazing, but throughout the month i realized it started to dry out my skin. it's gotten so bad to the point where my chin is literally peeling and burning from how dry it is.
I love this cleanser in the morning. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed and clean. My sensitive combo skin really likes it. It's non drying. I really like it.

I absolutely love this face was. I have been using for this for almost a year and can't picture myself stopping anytime soon. This face wash is very gentle but leaves my face feeling refreshed. I actually have a few products in this line and I just love them.i strongly recommend this face wash!

I bought this when it was on sale for half price , I'm glad I did not buy it at full price or else I will regret it . It did not help my skin to lighten the dark spots, in fact, it's dry out my skin , not a lot but it's still dry out of skin. I would love to keep using this cleanser if it wasn't dry out my skin . I think it's just decent cleanser.
DO NOT BUY THIS. I got it and it dries out my face so bad that it peeled for a month. Worst buy ever spend your money on something else.
I love my perricone cleanser ♥ ️, it gives me my face completely clean soft more will illuminate, it is helping me a lot with my uneven tone problem it is wonderful, ♥ ️🥰
So far my skin feels clean and looks brighter. I feel like my face looks refreshed.
I won't buy another cleanser ever again. If you're debating buying this, GET IT NOW.

avis.titre: New Packaging, but still a great cleanser
avis.texte: This is gentle, but removes makeup. I really liked the pump bottle. I hate that they went to this style of packaging, but still repurchased. If you like fresh soy facial cleanser or philosophy purity cleanser, you might want to try this one. This replaced those for me.

This products did not brighten my skin at all! In fact it cause me break out all over my face. I hate this product so much that I rather eat pickles then to buy this again. *To brighten your skin I would just recommend a vitamin C serum.

Bought this on sale and it was my first Perricone purchase. I had heard really good things about the products, so really disappointed the cleanser makes my skin feel SO dry! I liked the deep clean it gave, so I tried to mix it with a more moisturizing cleanser I had, but it still left my face really, really dry. Was hoping to like, and find a routine with some of the other brightening or firming products.
I really like this cleanser. It has a very light nice fragrance. It washes off my makeup well without drying my skin. It's a great value. You only use a little bit.

At very first when paired with the brightening serum and moisturizer you'll notice a difference! I'm just very upset because for the price I expect a packaging that's not faulty and won't spill! I lost 80% of the product because it spills and yes I fully close the lid every time so due to the packaging I give it low rating

After years of searching for a cleanser that would suit my skin, I finally found it. I have dry, sensitive and acne prone skin. With this product you will notice a difference, your skin is going to feel refreshed and vibrant! The gel is lightweight and a small pea size amount is all you need. I use this 2-3 times a week. Yes, it is expensive but the outcome is definitely worth it. Invest in this product, you won't regret it!

I love the Vitamin C serum in the Perricone line, so when it went on sale, I had to try it! It is lovely, light weight and definitely brightened after one use. Worth trying if you have dry, dull skin.

I'm 44, and this is the first cleanser I've ever loved and actually noticed a VISIBLE difference!! My daughter even noticed a difference in my skin when we were face timing! It gently and effectively removes all traces of make-up, even stubborn mascara. I'm extremely impressed with the results even in the short time I've been using it (about a week). My face is brighter, glowing, and I've noticed reduced pore size and overall texture. I'm so happy to have discovered this!!

Been using this nonstop since I got it. Super gentle and calming for my skin yet I feel like it's doing something and really cleaning my face. Some vitamin C face washes can be a little bit harsh on the skin and feel drying after but this one keeps my face really hydrated afterwards. Totally purchasing this again.
Use this daily night and day and in between if I have a workout etc. gentle yet cleansing. My skin is brighter when I use it. My husband uses this product too! We love it.

I am so glad that I purchased this cleanser. First, it smells great; it has a faint citrus smell to it. I've only been using this product consistently for a week after traveling and right away, I noticed the difference. It definitely evened my skin tone and my skin feel so moisturized as well. It's not drying me out at all. I am using this as a 2nd cleanser after an oil cleanser btw. Highly recommended.

avis.titre: I would buy again and again!
avis.texte: I wear make-up that is full coverage, so this cleanser really works well to completely remove it all. It's not irritating, and I have really sensitive skin.
The Citris Facial cleanser is so good, that if you don't have time for make-up, you'll still have a clean finished look after using it.

avis.titre: I will continue to purchase this over and over again!!
avis.texte: SOOO Im 37 and this is part of my staple and regimen. This is my morning wash and I love it! It wakes me yo and it gives me a bright Service/Delivery Comments My pump was broken! That's my only complaint which is HUGE considering I have to open it every morning to use but rather than that I love it and I'll open it up every morning if it means I can have clean skin with a great glow. I also noticed how my tone is more even. I don't wear makeup so skin and eyebrows along with a good lip is everything to me. Thanks Perricone for this amazing wash :)

avis.titre: This is my go to cleanser
avis.texte: I use this product every other day. I struggle to keep my skin clear and the best results I've had with any product come from the citrus brightening cleanser

avis.titre: Great product and amazing customer servise
avis.texte: I use after a cleansing oil and makeup is completely gone. Doesn't dry out skin at all.
I really like this cleanser, removes makeup and skin feels clean. I will buy it again.
I use one pump (that's all I need) twice a day. I love how it makes my skin feel clean but not stripped of moisture. My skin feels tightened and smooth.
I absolutely LOVE this face wash!!! It smells great and feels gentle but also cleans deep. I will definitely be rebuying when I run out.
I like to use this after I've been gardening for a few hours. It cleans and refreshes without stripping your skin of moisture. Leaves skin with a healthy glow.

avis.titre: I would buy again if it continues to be effective.
avis.texte: I use in morning and at night. I find it to be a gentle cleanser, and at the same time it seems to thoroughly clean my face and neck. It leaves my face feeling smooth and cleansed.
My skin looks clean and healthier than it has with other cleansers.

avis.titre: I prefer this cleanser to the nutritive cleanser.
avis.texte: This is my 'go to" PM cleanser. It deep cleans for a radiant complexion.

avis.titre: Mild! Pleasant! Effective! Works well on combination skin!
avis.texte: Works well as a daily cleanser! Cleans effectively as an all over cleanser! I am trying to clean and minimize my pores in my oily zone and I find this prepares for using the Intensive Pore Treatment. I follow this with the Haylo Plasma Moisturizer!

avis.titre: I have used this cleanser for many many years.
avis.texte: I use this cleanser alternating with the Gentle Cleanser every other day.
I use this product everyday. It works just like it is advertised.

avis.titre: Deep cleansing, but makes my skin glow
avis.texte: I wash my face twice a day...always...prior to going to bed, Citrus Wash take all makeup odd......and when I get up in the morning....(just a lesser amount).....skin glows.....then eye firming gel...moisturizer and Cold Plasma....

avis.titre: OlLDER CAN LOOK YOUNGER HEN YU USE PERRICONE
avis.texte: I LOVE Perricone products but I usually have to wait until they're on sale. Sometimes I splurge , I'm a guy and friends would make so much fun of me that I'd probably have to go into hiding, just kidding. My favorite is the cold plasma face cream. If you have a chance to procure any Perricone products, I insist or suggest is a better word. PROCURE PROCURE PROCURE. You won't be disappointed, I'm 64 but since using Perricone products everyone tells me that I look like in in my early 50's. I'll TAKE it.
I've only been using it for a couple of weeks and have a noticeable difference in the texture and suppleness of the skin on my face!

I'm not sure I'm a fan or not. I like the brand, so I might just need a different kind of facial wash. I feel like it does clean my face (removing almost all the makeup), but I feel like I have to use more (3 pumps) per cleansing to get the results I want and need. I've used other brand cleansers that cost less and clean better. Because of that, I'm only giving this 3-stars.
May be a great product for someone of a different age and skin type.
I use the facial wash morning and evening. The citrusy smell is so refreshing.
I have found that this cleanser is easy to use, doesn't strip my skin and leave it dry.
A great cleanser for fighting the affects of sun damage and sun exposure.

I was breaking out pretty bad and the Clinique face wash I was using was not helping at all. My skin is not oily, but I break out often on my t-zone and when I washed my face with the Clinique cleanser, the breakouts were still there and my skin started peeling because it was so dry. I bought this cleanser about a week ago and I swear it is a godsend. It smells amazing and it feels so gentle and soft. On the first day of using this product, my face felt much cleaner and softer. It was extremely refreshing. On day two, I noticed my acne started to clear up. On day three, my face was COMPLETELY CLEAR. I am head-over-heels for this product. I'm literally obsessed. It's that amazing. I doesn't even matter how old you are, what your skin type is, if you're a man or a woman, buy this product. I can promise you will not regret it.

By far I am satisfied with this product even after having doubts about its DMAE content. I have been using it for less than a week, thus the 3 stars. Felt tightening and total dryness the first time I used it, but after putting on my regular toner and serum (other brands), the Esther Vit C and Chloro Plasma, my skin felt smooth and hydrated.
This cleanser does not strip my skin. I am using 2-3 pumps to get everything off of my face though.

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again!
avis.texte: I moved to Williston, ND for the oilfield. I've now been here for 5 years where the weather is a lot dryer and very harsh winter conditions. My skin started to dry out,change texture, bigger pores, etc... I found this about 2 years ago and its completly changed the way I look for the better. I cant give this product a better review. My skin is back to being very moisturized, pores are smaller, and my skin looks great. I've tried various other products from here that also works great. It's a little on the more expensive side but it's worth it for the results. I'll keep coming back for more everytime! Thanks Dr. Perricone :)
I am happy with this product! It is gentle yet leaves my skin feeling clean. The smell is fresh. I use it daily and I think my skin is better for it!
Love how my skin has improved. I am 6 months away from 68 and everyone cannot believe that is my age.

I love the Citrus Facial Wash for my skin. It feels rich, comforting and a gental fragrance. I use it twice a day, smaller amount in the morning because I'm removing light debri before applying my makeup. I am caucasean - so I tend to have more fine lines and dryness- but never feel dry after this using product!

I use many Perricone products, but this cleanser has been my daily cleanser for a year and a half. I love the clean feeling my combination skin gets from this, but it's never drying, never irritates my sensitive skin and controls breakouts in my chin area. Worth its weight in gold!
I love this product! It thoroughly cleanses without irritating or stripping the skin. My skin wakes up when I use this cleanser.

I use this product every evening, along with Cold Plasma Eye, Cold Plasma and Sub-D. I have extremely sensitive skin and have had issues with most products but this line is awesome! I have minimal breakouts and my skin feels better than it ever has. Would recommend to everyone!

avis.titre: I will buy this product again.
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and this facial cleanser works great without any irritation and makes my skin feel soft and smooth. Another great Perricone product.

Each morning I look forward to cleansing my face with Citrus Facial Wash. It is similar to drinking a glass of freshly squeezed juice. There is no sting nor tingle. There is a gentle sensation that my face is glowing with new life. At night, my face gives up the last vestiges of whatever I have applied and, once again, my skin is aglow with a brightness. This is a great product. Anything that can make the user feel happy, is terrific!

I ABSOLUTELY love this cleanser!! I have used MANY different brands and this one beats all of them! It smells so refreshing and makes my skin feel amazingly soft. I have combination skin and this has worked great for my oily areas but doesn't dry my skin out. AMAZING!!
Have really noticed a differences in my skin texture and poor size.
This facial wash is amazing. Leaves skin glowing and refreshed. Follow this with intensive pore minimizer. You won't believe how beautiful you skin will look and feel.

I cleanse my face with this product every morning and evening. It cleans thoroughly and makes my skin look flawless, poreless. I wish it came in a larger bottle size so I wouldn't have to order it so often but I imagine that's because the smaller bottle assures its freshness.

The only suggestion I have is that it would come in a plastic bottle instead of glass. I keep mine in the shower, and that's an accident waiting to happen. Otherwise, I absolutely love the Citrus Facial Wash!

I normally don't feel my skin gets clean unless I'm using soap (moisturizing type), but this cleanser makes my skin feel clean. It doesn't feel dry at all. I use it twice a day. This is the real deal.
I love the Citrus facial wash; it removes make-up and doesn't dry out my skin. I've been using it for three years and don't plan on changing.

avis.titre: too harsh for my skin, sorry
avis.texte: This product came as a gift with an order of SubD which IS fantastic. However, this facial wash was just to harsh and dehydrating for my skin. I'm sure it cleaned my skin well, but the after effects were not great - my face went quite red and I had to immediately moisturise to soothe it back to normal. This product would much better suit a person with greasy, oily, combination skin....sensitive and dry skin requires something a lot more gentle and soothing. sorry....I really LOVE Perricone products, just not this one :(

I trade off on my daily cleanser-I use this Citrus Wash and then use the Nutritive Cleanser. (Because I have issues that both address!) I've found that if you use a daily cleanser you truly do see cumulative effects-hence the title "Daily Cleanser"? ;-) I had humongous pores on my nose and chin when I first started using the a Citrus Wash along with pretty severe sun damage on my cheeks and forehead . At first I only used it when I saw my pores looking 'bad', but after a week of using it every day I noticed that they had quit looking 'bad'! That was enough to convince me! Then my niece came to visit and took one look at me exclaiming, " Aunt! Your face looks so marvelous! What have you been doing! I want it!" Need I say more?

This cleanser really does clean your skin. That should be a given for any cleanser, but it's not. The last 4 cleansers I have tried (all from expensive brands)have left makeup on my skin after cleansing (I'm talking cleansing for 2-4min using a Clairsonic AFTER using a makeup remover!), and I don't wear very much makeup. So to find a cleanser that does what it's supposed to do is exciting. Besides actually doing it's job and cleaning my skin, it hasn't dried out my skin even though it seems to thoroughly remove oil. My skin looks more toned after using it. I bought this cleanser as part of the Pore Prescription Set, along with Cold Plasma and the Advanced Evening Repair. I started using all of the products at the same time. I use the entire Pore Prescription Set in the AM, applying Cold Plasma after the toner and before the pore treatment. In PM I use this cleanser, the toner, Cold Plasma, then Advanced Evening Repair. I don't know which of these products is doing the heavy lifting, or if they all just work brilliantly together, but after 3 weeks of following this regimen, my skin has NEVER looked better! From the time I turned 19 until today (I'm 35) I have had uneven, splotchy skin. I have struggled with cyctic hormonal breakouts, stress breakouts, enlarged pores, and blackheads on my nose and cheeks. Not only do I always have at least two huge pimples to cover up at any given time, usually more, but now I'm getting wrinkles on my forhead and around my nose. My skin can go

I have used this for 8 days. From the first day it left my skin feeling and looking really clean. By day 2, pores appeared smaller and this continues. They are still there but less noticeable. Each time I use it my skin looks the way it does after a professional facial. It now has a healthy sheen. I don't use a moisturizer at night and on day 6 my skin started to get dry, so I just ordered the Photo Plasma. Hope it's the right choice!

I usually would consider myself a 'Budget Buyer', but when I received this Citrus Wash as a sample from Sephora--I was immediately hooked on Perricone MD products! I am over 50 yrs old, but have a multitude of skin issues of all ages--lucky me! This Citrus Wash helps with the large pores on my nose and chin, and with continued use appears to have helped with my oily skin on my T-zone. My friends and family have complimented me on the appearance of my skin since i've started using this line of skin products-which is enough to get me to switch!
I have tried this a couple of times and I really can't stomach the smell. It smells too fishy and I've tried to like it, but want to gag every time I'm in the shower.

I've been using Perricone products for several years and the Citrus Facial Cleanser is a staple. The best feature of this product is that with continued use you can see the collagen boosting effects (i.e. your skin looks "thicker" as if you had worked out your faccial muslces in the gym). Pretty remarkable results for only a cleanser. Of course I follow up with treatment and moisturizer, but no doubt this cleanser has the most impact. Highly recommend this product.

I have been searching for a great cleanser forever, and only wish I had found Dr. Perricone sooner. With every other cleanser I have tried, my skin has always felt tight and dry, and then by the end of the day, was very shiny and oily looking. Citrus Facial Wash is a gentle cleanser, that not only takes off all my make up at the end of the day, but leaves my skin nourished, and soft, and best of all, NO MORE shiny forehead in the afternoons. LOVE LOVE LOVE.

I tried this because I can't stand the smell of the Nutritive Cleanser. I had high hopes, but this dried out my skin terribly. Tried it for two weeks and literally had new wrinkles appear. I have normal skin, not dry, not oily. The remainder is going in the garbage.

I purchased the "Cold Plasma Sub-D Kit" & received this Citrus Facial Wash along with it. I usually don't use washes, just rinse my face off @ the end of the day. I decided to go the whole nine yards with this product line, and am I glad I did! After three days, THREE, mind you-the pores on my nose (which have costs my a large amount of money my whole life!) while not quite invisible (yet!) are so much smaller, and cleaned out! Amazing! I've really tried almost everything. I've used those expensive rotating brushes to get my pores clean-does't do what this does! Expensive masks, glycolic peels, nothing has done as much as what this has in 3 short days! (Can't wait for 3 weeks.) I usually don't believe these reviews that 'gush' about a product line, but seriously people, this is fantastic stuff! I think I have finally found something that works, which actually does what it claims it will do. Thank you Dr. Perricone.
This is an excellent cleanser. It is great to remove makeup. My skin always feels so clean, yet not stripped or dry at all

I just recently purchased the citrus face wash and immediately fell in love with it. I work nights as a nurse and constantly break out around my chin. I have to say it is refreshing to come home and wash my face, I actually look forward to it. Not only is this face wash refreshing, but it has cleared up my skin a lot! It also makes my face feel clean and dry without a greasy feeling. I'm excited to continue using this product and currently looking into more to purchase.

I would give this five stars if the pump worked properly. I have recieved three bottles and the pump has never worked the way it should. Other than that, I love this face wash product, it cleans my skin without drying, removes makeup without stripping.

I've been using this facial wash for one year and I'm very happy with the results. after washing my face I feel my skin a little bit tight but after I used my moisturizing cream, my face is bright. I have acne prone skin and I used in combination with clarisonic pro. After using this combination my skin texture improved a lot. my skin is brighter and flawless. Is a very nice product, removes makeup and glitter very easily and you don't need too much product. so my bottle last 6 months.

I've been looking for a great "C" cleanser without parabens and other toxins, and this is the one! It goes on smoothly, smells nice, and rinses off really clean. I use it around the eye area without tears. It doesn't dry my combination skin, and gives it such a beautiful, fresh glow! My skin never feels tight or dry after using this cleanser. It leaves my skin with just the right balance to add my treatments and cosmetics. I would recommend this cleanser to anyone. Love it, and can't get enough!

I have been using the Citrus face wash for only two weeks and I can't believe what it has done for my skin. I have always fought acne, even now in my 40's. This face wash has cleared my skin and I no longer have to use harsh products like Benzoyl Peroxide. The results have been softer, smoother, acne-free skin. Thank you!!

avis.titre: Best Cleanser I have ever used.
avis.texte: I use it morning and evening. Before this cleanser, I hadn't used a cleanser in the am for several years, just warm water, because other cleansers were too drying to use twice per day. NOT the case with Citrus Fascial Wash. It cleanses thoroughly, removing make-up and grime, without drying out my skin. I have sensitive and moderately oily skin. Don't be discouraged by the size, it's a concentrated cleanser. One small pump is enough to cleanse face and neck. There isn't anything I don't like about this product.

avis.titre: Great for sensitive and oily skin
avis.texte: I have oily skin and used to have acne. Most of the other skin cleansers I used were too drying and harsh. I like the clean feeling I get without the stripping of facial oils. It is gentle and effective and works well with the other Perricone products.
love it...it prepares my skin for daytime and night time Dr. Perricone products....friends have noticed a "glowing skin"
Best cleanserI have ever used in all my life. Trust me,tried them all.I found a huge slice of sanity and beautiful piece of Heaven.

Before using this product my face felt irritated and my mild hormonal acne made my cheek area feel as though it was on fire. Instantly when i used this product, my face felt cool and less irritated. The next morning my face was no longer red and blotchy. Best part, my acne flare up was gone. This product help me get rid of all the irritation that my face was experiencing. My face glows! I'm definitely investing in more of Dr. Perricone's products.
I have stopped using any other cleanser on my face. My skin feels as soft as silk and a little "tingly" after washing with this cleanser. This is a permanent addition to my skin care routine.

I have been using N.V.Perricone products for 10 years. This is my favorite cleanser, as it shrinks my large pores, and balances my oily/combination skin, (even though I am in my early 50's).Dr.Perricone cleansers are the only ones that don't dry out or aggravate my very, sensitive skin, (I am a fair skinned, red head).I use this cleanser twice a day.

The only downside to this product is that it does not effectively remove water-proof/water-resistant makeup (not that I need it to do so, that's what makeup remover is for!). Honestly, I am completely willing to overlook that fact given how amazing it is. As someone who is prone to spots/acne, this cleanser has definitely helped tremendously with my problem skin (something I noticed after using this product for only 2 weeks!). As an added benefit, my previously combination skin has now become normal (and gets alot less greasy throughout the day).
